title: Cache crashed and stayed down
reason: The engineer blamed the Redis upgrade as the cause, but the real crash was a one‑off bug with no external trigger.
root_cause: The cache (Redis) container crashed with a SIGSEGV after being upgraded from Redis 7.2 to 7.4, causing the API to lose connection to Redis and return 500/503 errors for login and cart operations.
truth: Redis crashed once on a rare bug (signal 11, segmentation fault). The container has no restart policy, so it stayed down, and login and cart, which keep sessions in Redis, fail.
